problem: P43 original factual_ready is count>=min_facts, even when all actions are identical or action schedule is exactly confounded with elapsed time: neither supplies evidence to separate action effects from affine nuisance.
change: Isolated nontrainable sidecar adds a factual [1, cumulative_elapsed, executed_action] 3x3 information Gram, requires full relative rank and at least three actual facts before P43 may select an action. Preserves original recurrent model source, parameters and training; previews read-only.

local_verification.initial_test_failure: Test asserted count-drift error but PSD test ran first; validation order corrected without relaxing validation

limitations: Rank is necessary only under a locally affine nuisance; it does not prove causal identification under nonlinear drift, endogenous action selection or unobserved confounding
Does not fix P43-C independent failed comparator experiment or establish better-than-GRU/strong-ridge performance
Does not authenticate factual external outcomes
No new model training, scientific first-use, hidden test samples, or independent transfer evaluated
